name: Eric Xing
bio: Eric Xing is president of Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI), a role effective since January 2021, and a professor of computer science at Carnegie Mellon University, where Xing founded the SAILING Lab. Xing's research covers machine learning systems, probabilistic models and distributed training, and Xing co-founded the machine learning company Petuum in 2016.
